mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, John Ehlers' published Reversion Index fast Trigger crossing its slower Smooth line on completed four-hour BTC auctions identifies timely peaks and valleys in ranging volatile markets; follow the newly indicated direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when period-4 SuperSmoothed Reversion Trigger strictly crosses above period-8 Reversion Smooth; short on the strict cross below
mechanism.why_distinct: The raw field is the length-20 signed path displacement divided by total absolute path variation, then two different two-pole SuperSmoothers cross. It is not RSI, a price/range oscillator, raw return sign, moving-average price crossover, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the 2026 publication explicitly presents the indicator for mean-reversion peaks and valleys and reports the crossover example working well on a volatile stock; the crossing must also occur while trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation ranks in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: dual-smoothed signed-path-efficiency turning-point crossings are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.ratio: sum of the last twenty completed close differences divided by their summed absolute values, invalid when denominator is zero
features.smooth: published period-8 two-pole SuperSmoother of Ratio
features.trigger: published period-4 two-pole SuperSmoother of Ratio
features.event: strict finite Trigger-minus-Smooth zero crossing relative to the immediately prior valid decision
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.recursive_reset: invalid completed four-hour bars reset both smoothing states; initialize each first three smoother outputs to its current Ratio; require at least 23 uninterrupted observations and finite current/prior fields

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: published Ehlers length-20 Reversion Index SS4/SS8 crossover under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no length, smoothing, initialization, crossover, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: John F. Ehlers, The Reversion Index, TASC January 2026
external_basis.fixed_definition: Length=20; Ratio=sum of Close-previous Close over Length divided by sum absolute changes; Smooth=SuperSmoother(Ratio,8); Trigger=SuperSmoother(Ratio,4); published implementations buy when Trigger crosses above Smooth and sell when it crosses below
external_basis.selection_use: published default length, ratio, smoothing periods, crossover, and side only; no incidence or outcomes
